description.narrative: Project 6 will finance the water supply and sanitation systems in Marneuli, Bolnisi, and Chiatura. The first component includes construction of: (i) water supply and sewerage systems, including a new sewage treatment plant (STP) in Marneuli; (ii) the sewerage system in Bolnisi which will be connected to the Marneuli STP; and (iii) the water supply system and a new STP in Chiatura. Project 6 will benefit approximately a population of 37,380 in Marneuli, 9,000 in Bolnisi, and 15,400 in Chiatura. The second component includes project implementation support.

description.narrative: Improved water supply and sanitation services.

c. A total of 61,780 people will receive safe and improved water and sanitation services of whom 50% are females by 2024. Progress/Status: Actual population benefitting from the project will be reported at end of project implementation. ADB Board approved extension of MFF availability period for 3 years from 29 March 2021 to 29 March 2024, and extension of T3-T6 has also been approved. Data Source: Annual sex disaggregated socioeconomic surveys undertaken as part of the PPMS to determine public satisfaction with the quality of water supply and sanitation. Actual value:

Residents' access to safe sanitation increased from 19% 2015 to 100% in 2024 in Marneuli and from 39% in 2015 to 100% in 2024 in Bolnisi through provision of sewer connections to all existing households, and a sewage treatment plant commissioned in Marneuli for safe disposal of sewage by 2024. Progress/Status: The wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) in Marneuli was awarded in October 2019 and deployment to the site was on 9 Dec 2019. The works were suspended due to the population complaints against flooding incidents in July 2020. This has been addressed and the works have resumed since January 2021.
Works for construction of Marneuli WWTP could not be completed before Loan Closing date i.e. 29 March 2024. The Government will finance remaining works. Completion is planned by end of 2024. Data Source: National statistics on water supply quality and effluent discharge from MOEPA and UWSCG. Actual value:

Residents' access to safe water supply increased from 69% in 2015 to 100 % in 2024 in Marneuli and from 89% in 2015 to 100 % in 2022 in Chiatura. Progress/Status: Section 1 of water supply network in Chiatura completed, with defects notification period extended to 30 June 2022. A new Section 2 was approved for additional network connections in the Chiatura area. Construction of Section 2 is experiencing 3-4 month delays, but will be completed within 2021. Although the majority of the contract is in Section 1 which is already delivering water to the population, it is important to complete the Section 2 to ensure additional connections to households and maximize the benefits to the population. The Contract has been terminated in January 2024. The works have been substantially completed and delivering the water to the population. However minor part of the works (Section 2) is remaining to be completed, that is going to be financed by the Government.
Contract for water supply and sewerage system in Marneuli and Bolnisi was awarded in November 2018. The contract is experiencing substantial delays due to the poor performance of the contractor. A dedicated engineer at IPMO is directly supervising and monitoring the contract. Despite high level discussions amongst contractual parties since Q4 2020, contractor performance failed to improve. In addition, workers rallied against unpaid wages by the contractor. CWUW and GRM have coordinated responses to media inquiries on this matter, in close coordination with PPFD, DOC and OAI.
The Contract has been Terminated in November 2021.
After rebidding, the works have been awarded in 6 lots.
Despite acceleration and good pace of the works in 2023, works could not be completed before Loan Closing date i.e. 29 March 2024, for 3 out of 6 Lots. Works are substantially completed. The Government is financing minor remaining works. Data Source: National statistics on water supply quality and effluent discharge from MOEPA and UWSCG. Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Project implementation support and public awareness program effectively implemented, information on hygiene and sanitation disseminated. Indicator: 2b. Service center in Marneuli, Bolnisi, and Chiatura having a customer care unit staffed by at least 30% women by 2023 that informs, educates, and communicates on water, hygiene, and sanitation. (Baseline 2015: 77% male; 22% female) Progress/Status: Service center in Marneuli established. Data Source: Semiannual progress reports prepared by UWSCG,PPMS reports prepared by UWSCG, and UWSCG annual work plans. Actual value:

Output: Water supply and sewerage system efficiency improved through rehabilitation and reconstruction, and extended coverage. Indicator: 1a. About 17.6 km of main transmission line, 188 km of distribution network, 10,400 cum capacity reservoir, 1037 m3/h pumping station, 32 m3/h booster pumping Station constructed and replaced in Marneuli by 2023. Progress/Status: Works have been substantially completed. Remaining portion is financed by the Government. Details to be assessed during the preparation of the PCR. Data Source: Semi-annual progress reports prepared by UWSCG, PPMS reports prepared by UWSCG, and Project component completion and commissioning certificates provided by investment program construction supervision consultant Actual value:

Output: Water supply and sewerage system efficiency improved through rehabilitation and reconstruction, and extended coverage. Indicator: 1b. 127.5 km of sewer line, 10 sewage pumping stations, and a sewage treatment plant (STP) of capacity about 13.89 MLD (1st phase) constructed to treat and safely discharge of sewage in Marneuli and Bolnisi by 2023. Progress/Status: The contract for Marneuli sewage treatment plant was awarded in October 2019 and commencement was on 6 Dec 2019. Design works have stopped due to complaints from the population stemming from a flooding incident at the site. Construction of the STP is delayed and completion is planned by end of 2024. Works beyond the loan closing date are financed by the Government.
Sewer lines are substantially completed. Remaining portion of the works are financed by the Government.
Details to be assessed during preparation of the PCR. Data Source: Semi-annual progress reports prepared by UWSCG, PPMS reports prepared by UWSCG, and Project component completion and commissioning certificates provided by investment program construction supervision consultant Actual value:

Progress/Status: Works for pipe laying in Bolnisi are completed. Data Source: Semi-annual progress reports prepared by UWSCG, PPMS reports prepared by UWSCG, and Project component completion and commissioning certificates provided by investment program construction supervision consultant Actual value:

Progress/Status: Works have been substantially completed. Remaining portion is financed by the Government. Details to be assessed during the preparation of the PCR.
